args.body:
Dear John,

Please find attached the minutes from our recent client meeting held on May 5, 2024.

Summary:
- We discussed your requirements for the new project and agreed on the overall project timeline and key milestones.
- Initial design concepts were reviewed, and your feedback was gathered for further improvements.
- Action items include updating the project plan based on your feedback and starting the initial development phase.

The next meeting is scheduled for 2024-06-01.

Please let us know if you have any questions or additional feedback.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
